title: SEXTOLUGAR — Store

hero.title:
Playing is free.
Going deep has a price.
hero.sub: Come in, create a room, play with your group — no payment required. The packs exist for those who want to take the experience further.

packs.title: Card Packs
packs.sub: Each pack changes the dynamics of the ritual. Buy before or during the session.

conexao.name: Connection
conexao.desc: Light, emotional cards. They build a bond before the discomfort. Perfect for groups that just got together — or haven't truly seen each other in a while.
conexao.example: "Tell us something you've never had the courage to say out loud to this group."

verdades.name: Truths
verdades.desc: More direct. Mild but real discomfort. You'll want to know the answers — and you'll be uncomfortable with them.
verdades.example: "What was the last lie you told someone in this room?"

conflito.name: Conflict
conflito.desc: Real provocations. Exposes old tensions. Forces the group to name what's usually kept in silence.
conflito.example: "Pick someone here. What would you never say to their face — but everyone already knows?"

segredos.name: Secrets
segredos.desc: Intense. Psychological. Cards that make people stop breathing for a few seconds before answering.
segredos.example: "What would you do if you were absolutely certain no one would ever know?"

casais.name: Couples
casais.desc: Niche for two. Opens what was closed, touches what was avoided, reveals what became silence from being so normal.
casais.example: "What haven't you told me yet about the day we met?"

inSession.title: In-Game Purchases
inSession.sub: They appear at the right moment. Always optional. Never break the ritual's flow.

blocked.name: Locked Card
blocked.desc: Appears when the free deck reaches its limit. Unlocks the next card to continue — or skip for free.

final.name: Final Reveal Card
final.desc: A rare event. A high-impact emotional card emerges at the moment of greatest tension in the group.

second.name: Second Chance
second.desc: When the deck ends and the group is still engaged — adds 3 extra cards to continue.

premium.title: Premium Rooms
premium.sub: Total control of the experience. No time limit, no locked cards.

private.name: Premium Private Room
private.desc: A room with full control for you and your group. No duration limit, no card interruptions.
private.feat1: Full access to all decks you own
private.feat2: No card lock during the entire session
private.feat4: Access control — only those you want come in

ritual.name: Ritual Mode
ritual.desc: Turns the session into a fully immersive experience. Activates visual layers and maximum-intensity cards.
ritual.feat2: Immersive visual effects in the room

recording.title: Ritual Recording
recording.sub: Save what happened. Sessions like this don't repeat — and they have viral potential.

cosmetics.title: Aesthetics of the Ritual
cosmetics.sub: Complementary, not essential. Change how the room looks and feels.

theme.name: Room Theme
theme.desc: Noir, Forest, Ocean, Desert — each theme completely changes the colors and atmosphere of the room.

cardStyle.name: Card Style
cardStyle.desc: Changes the back and front design — gold, obsidian, parchment or neon.

fx.name: Visual Effects
fx.desc: Particles, mist, pulses of light — visual layers that elevate the session's atmosphere.

placeholders.name: How you'd like to be called

checkout.secure: Secure payment · Automatic activation after confirmation · Charged in BRL
